action: opened the order: Invent one new widget that goes beyond everything in the catalog. One remarkable idea, or none.
Untapped capability: proposed Gearbox (per-step effort via turn.step rewrite), Reflex (turn.step answered with no request), Attic (tool.describe deferral)
person at the terminal: proposed Landmarks (landmarks-widget), Leftovers (leftovers-widget), Gloss (gloss-widget)
Delight: proposed Unsaid (unsaid-widget), Hands (hands-widget), Jar (jar-widget)
took the order at ideation

stamped reject on "Reflex": It saves one model request on an exact repeated prompt at the price of a transcript step the model never wrote, and it rests on an unproven assumption that a synthesized tool call with no signed thinking block is accepted by the next request.

stamped reject on "Attic": The engine already defers tools behind ToolSearch, the tokens it would save are cached ones, and hiding a built-in tool Claude does not know to look for costs more than the saving.

stamped reject on "Gloss": A variation on stakes-widget and pen-widget: the permission dialog already carries a plain description of the command, and a bundled flag table covers only a few dozen commands.

stamped reject on "Hands": A variation on theseus-widget and history-widget: most lines Claude edits in a session are ones it wrote minutes earlier, so the card is usually 'not committed yet' or your own name.
stamped reject on "Jar": It is a counter of phrases, which the inventor ranks weakest, and it overlaps the waiting mirror-widget.

stamped reject on "Gearbox": Not chosen: it lowers the quality of steps by fixed rules the person cannot see being wrong, and its saving is unproven until someone measures whether a change of effort inside a turn breaks the prompt cache.

stamped reject on "Leftovers": Not chosen: useful, but it is strays-widget for code built from the same commit-time notice as stakes-widget and customs-widget, and critic-widget already reads the diff for debris.
stamped reject on "Unsaid": Not chosen: a fine joke told once, but it keeps text the person chose to delete and gives nothing to do with it, where Landmarks is used in every long session.
named the widget landmarks-widget ("Landmarks")

stamped pass: Landmarks is the first widget that moves the transcript instead of sitting beside it: a jump list through $.ui.scroll, which exists in the types and no shipped widget calls, used in every long session at no token cost.
